_comment: Published, rule-based weather suitability criteria shown next to (never instead of) model risk. Each profile MUST cite its source; add diseases only with a verified reference. crop/disease use AgriGuard canonical names.

profiles.source: Hutton Criteria for potato late blight (Phytophthora infestans), AHDB Potatoes / James Hutton Institute (Dancey, Skelsey & Cooke, 2017), which replaced the Smith Period in Great Britain.
profiles.description: Two consecutive days, each with a minimum temperature of at least 10 °C and at least 6 hours of relative humidity at or above 90 %.
